gameplan.summary: Assassinate squishy carries with W+R combo. Snowball kills before enemy builds armor.
gameplan.win_condition: One-shot the enemy ADC or APC in every teamfight. Use shadows for mobility escapes.
gameplan.early_game: Q poke safely. Level 6 first kill window. Never waste W — it's your only escape.
gameplan.positioning: Flank from fog of war. W behind enemy carries. Ult onto isolated target, never into frontline.

ahri.tips: She charms you during ult — walk unpredictably. She will buy Zhonya's; plan around it.
ahri.power_shift: You win if she's behind. Even matchup with Zhonya's in play.

lissandra.tips: Her ult counters your Death Mark entirely — she ults herself to negate it. Delay ult until her ult is down.
lissandra.power_shift: She hard-counters you. Win through roaming to other lanes rather than fighting her.

malzahar.tips: His E silence stops your combo. His ult suppresses you — build QSS. Avoid extended fights.
malzahar.power_shift: He counters your kit. Win by roaming aggressively and avoiding him.

orianna.tips: Dodge her Q-W poke. Shadow jump her and kill before she can get ball protection from teammates.
orianna.power_shift: You win 1v1 early. She wins teamfights at 3 items. Kill her before 20 minutes.

katarina.tips: Both are all-in assassins — fight for level 6 first kill. Don't let her reset daggers.
katarina.power_shift: She outscales in teamfights with resets. Win through solo kills before she gets 2 items.
